channel.title: Wire — Releases
channel.description: Releases from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: AWS Lambda now supports 90-minute function timeout on Lambda Managed Instances
item.description: AWS Lambda now supports a 90-minute function timeout for asynchronous and event source mapping (ESM) invocations on Lambda Managed Instances (LMI) , a 6x increase from the previous 15-minute limit. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Lambda now supports Graviton5-powered EC2 instances on Lambda Managed Instances
item.description: AWS Lambda now supports AWS Graviton5-powered C9g, C9gd, M9g, and M9gd instances on Lambda Managed Instances . (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base adds APIs and console support for debugging document-level access control
item.description: AWS announces the CheckIngestedDocumentAcl and GetIngestedDocumentAcl APIs for Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base, giving customers a self-service way to debug document access issues and audit document-level permissions. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base now supports Confluence Data Center as a native data source connector
item.description: AWS announces the Confluence Data Center data source connector for Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base, a fully managed retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) service. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Transform for .NET modernization is now generally available via CLI
item.description: Today, AWS announced the general availability of an AWS-managed transformation for .NET modernization in AWS Transform custom that you can trigger with a single one-line CLI command. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Connect Customer now lets you set specific capacity limits for different types of Tasks and Emails
item.description: Amazon Connect Customer now gives contact center managers the ability to set specific capacity limits for different kinds of work. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Twenty Years of jQuery: How a Little Library Rewired Web Development
item.description: jQuery, created by John Resig and released in 2006, is a JavaScript library that simplifies HTML manipulation, event handling, animation, and Ajax. It enabled easier web development by providing an accessible API across browsers. (3 sources: frontendfocus, infoq, javascriptweekly)
